_comment: Rows of the map, grouped by job. Each lane is one row; 'after' starts the lane one column right of that cookbook. Consecutive steps get an arrow: green when both are live on main, orange when one is still a pull request or planned. A cookbook sits in the first lane that names it. A 'parallel' lane draws no arrows between its steps; a 'linked' lane draws a two-headed arc between every pair of its steps, for cookbooks with no order between them. Cookbooks on no lane land in 'Not on a path yet'. 'planned' lists cookbooks that do not exist yet; 'owners' tags any cookbook with who is building it; 'hidden' leaves cookbooks off the map. Edit, then click 'Rebuild'.

lanes.name: 1. Context
lanes.why: Three sources keep context/ current: the website and news, every recorded call, and won and lost deals.

lanes.name: 2. Fundamentals
lanes.why: Source the universe from the ICP, fill the records, merge duplicates, score what is left.

lanes.name: 3. Signals
lanes.why: Market-wide triggers that tell you who to reach and when.

lanes.name: 4. Engagement
lanes.why: Once accounts are scored: source their stakeholders, let agents hold the conversations, and pick up the rest in one inbox.

lanes.name: 5. Operations
lanes.why: Logs feed the daily digest, the weekly recap, and on-demand answers.
